note: Pilot-independent ground-contact audit of a flight log (haltere.liftoff.contact_audit; offline scoring only, never read by a pilot). It counts contacts from the telemetry alone: the vertical specific force the thrust of the game's processed throttle (the measured curve of runs/measured-dynamics-low-speed-20260923/profile.json: full_input_twr, exponent, translation_drag_s_inv), gravity and drag cannot explain; the arrest of a descent below hover thrust; off-axis impacts (flightlog.collisions' criterion); the recorded height; and the runner's terminal impact. The values were set on design logs (validation.design_logs) before this freeze; the validation below is frozen with them and scored afterwards. The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256; a change needs a new version and a new freeze.

audit_notes.support: support: the external vertical force averaged over window_s (centred) >= support_on + support_rate_gain x max(0, the window's highest body rate - rate_free), with the drive (in_thr+1)/2 within [drive_min, drive_max] on every frame of the window
audit_notes.arrest: arrest: vz <= -arrest_descent at the window start, the drive at or below the hover drive for the window and arrest_lookback_s before it, and a mean (dvz/dt + drag_z) >= arrest_accel over the window
audit_notes.impact: impact: 3-frame mean acceleration > impact_accel with > impact_offaxis off the thrust axis
audit_notes.episodes: frames closer than merge_s form one contact; a contact needs min_s of support or arrest, or one impact frame; kind slide when supported >= slide_s at a median horizontal speed >= slide_speed; frames before arming_s or before the first departure (|z| > depart_m) are not scored

design_logs.first_attempt: an unrecorded subset of logs; its frame grabs point to pine-fast6-ttc-01, pine-brain08-01, straw-fast6-03, straw-fast6-arc-01 and straw-brain06-02. It cannot be excluded that it also ran its draft on validation logs: the validation is not blind
design_logs.note: the audit's values are the first attempt's draft, checked unchanged on the second attempt's design logs (all contacts it reported there were at hill, hilltop, uphill-skim or Pine impact spots; two uphill skims and a hilltop tumble were confirmed on the videos)

straw_downhill.labels: the ten support-climb onsets of straw-brain08-04/-06 on the downhill; each confirmed on the video before the freeze (contact sheets every 0.2 s from onset-1.6 s: the camera at ground level with grass and straw close in front, 0.6-1.0 s before each onset)
straw_downhill.pass_rule: an audit contact overlapping [onset + window_s[0], onset + window_s[1]] for >= min_detected

slide.labels: the video shows the drone sliding on the hillside (camera at ground level, grass close) from 70.6 s to the impact at about 75.9 s; 68.8-70.0 s is not clear on the video (the log shows vz -0.5..-0.7 m/s at a drive below hover from 68.5 s)
slide.pass_rule: audit contacts cover >= min_coverage of the window, one of them of kind slide

floor.labels: the garage floor is the launch plane (z launch-relative): z < 0.1 m at 27.4-28.9 s and 29.1-29.6 s; the dark video does not show the touch clearly
floor.pass_rule: an audit contact overlapping the first window (the second is reported)

validation.terminal_rule: every run that ended on the runner's impact is listed with its terminal record (reported: whether the CSV carries contact evidence in its last terminal_s)

false_positives.procedure: every audit contact outside the labelled windows, not within terminal_s of the end of a run that ended on an impact, and (Minus Two, whose floor is the launch plane) not within height_confirmed_m of the launch plane, is looked up on the video: a sheet of 12 frames from t_start - 0.4 s to t_end + 0.2 s (contact_audit.review_sheets). Label 'contact' when the frames show the drone touching the ground or an object (the camera at ground level with the surface close, debris, a tumble or a jolt at an obstacle), 'none' when it is clearly airborne throughout, 'ambiguous' otherwise; 'none', 'ambiguous' and a missing label count as false positives. More than max_review items: a seeded random sample of max_review is labelled and the count scaled. Rate: false positives per minute of scored flight over every log
false_positives.pass_rule: false positives per scored minute <= max_per_min
